notes: Replays through block-destructive-commands.sh, not the gate hook: a destructive recursive-delete command whose argument is double-quoted and contains a $ expansion. The guard only inspects commands from a non-whitelisted subagent, so the payload carries agent_type task-group-implementer - without it the guard exits silently and the deny below is unreachable. The deny reason must come back as well-formed JSON built with jq -n --arg, which is what the quoting fix at :30-38 guarantees; the pre-fix form produced invalid JSON for exactly this input. No gate state is involved. The replay harness mounts state_fixture at cwd_layout under a temporary directory and rewrites the payload cwd and every absolute path in the tool input to that mount point; the paths below are written against the canonical layout <cwd>/.maister/umbrella/runs/<run-id>/.
